scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install --no-fund --no-audit && node scripts/backend.mjs setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "node scripts/backend.mjs dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/backend.mjs serve
scripts.test: node scripts/backend.mjs test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
